tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: ASK US FOR WHAT IS NOT HERE. What would you like to buy? Tell us even if it is not in this inventory. If what you need is a machine-readable convention, or a property of one across a host population, we can usually measure it for you — and if we cannot, we will say so. Call the `request_capability`

tools.name: absence_rate
tools.description: Measured absence rate for a population, with the evaluated denominator and sample provenance. Pass `gap_class` (e.g. PH-C019) for one class; omit it for the whole table. Aggregate only: no per-host findings.

tools.name: adoption_curve
tools.description: Dated adoption series: share of sites whose robots.txt takes a stance on AI agents, by Common Crawl epoch, single vantage. Called with no arguments it returns the trend and the caveats, not the whole table. Pass `epoch` for one point, `series: true` for all of them, or `withheld: true` for the under

tools.name: host_report
tools.description: Per-host findings. Requires a bearer credential.

tools.name: bulk_export
tools.description: Per-class numerators with Wilson intervals and the discarded-as-unknown share, Kaplan-Meier survival of directive adoption by cohort, directive lineage, declaration growth, and RFC 9728 auth-discovery conformance detail — none of it on the free surface — with an ed25519 attestation naming the chain

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "host_report" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Per-host findings. Requires a bearer credential.
